_note: 學習路徑內容建置第18批 #5／6：過去完成式（eng.t_adv.verb.past-perfect，學測級／高階）。過去完成式用 had + 過去分詞，表示在過去某時間點/動作之前就已完成的事（過去的過去）；有兩個過去動作時標出『先發生』的那個；常與 by the time／before／after 搭配；already/just/never 放在 had 和過去分詞中間。誘答全部以文法硬錯（has 代 had／原形或過去式代過去分詞／would／進行式語意不合）鎖唯一正解，刻意不放『簡單過去式也可接受』的誘答以免有第二正解。皆標準英語，經對抗式英語母語複核。音檔 edge-tts 童聲（prefix pstp_）。

units.title_zh: 過去完成式（had + 過去分詞）
units.can_do: 我能用過去完成式（had + 過去分詞）表達在過去某時間點之前就完成的事，並在兩個過去動作中標出先發生的那個（by the time／before／after）。
units.subject: eng

claims.text: The past perfect is formed with 'had' + past participle: 'had finished', 'had gone', 'had left'.
claims.verification_ref: 過去完成式＝had + 過去分詞；had left；對抗式英語母語 reviewer 複核

claims.text: The past perfect shows that one action happened before another action or time in the past (the 'earlier past'): 'When I arrived, the train had already left.'
claims.verification_ref: 過去完成式表某事在過去另一動作/時間之前已發生（過去的過去）；When I arrived, the train had already left；對抗式英語母語 reviewer 複核

claims.text: With 'by the time / before / after', the past perfect marks the action that happened first: 'By the time we got there, the shop had closed.'
claims.verification_ref: by the time/before/after 搭配時，過去完成式標出先發生者；By the time we got there, the shop had closed；對抗式英語母語 reviewer 複核

claims.text: Adverbs like 'already, just, never, yet' often appear between 'had' and the past participle: 'She had just finished.'
claims.verification_ref: already/just/never/yet 常放在 had 與過去分詞之間；She had just finished；對抗式英語母語 reviewer 複核

teach.body: 過去完成式用『had + 過去分詞』，表示在過去某個時間點或動作『之前就已經完成』的事，可以說是『過去的過去』。When I arrived, the train had already left.（我到的時候火車已經開走了——火車先走、我後到。）
When I arrived, the train had already left.　（我到時火車已經開走了。had left 比 arrived 更早發生。）
有兩個過去動作時，用過去完成式標出『先發生』的那個。By the time we got home, it had stopped raining.（我們到家時，雨已經停了。had stopped 先、got 後。）
By the time we got home, it had stopped raining.　（我們到家時雨已經停了。had stopped 先、got 後。）
already、just、never、yet 這些副詞常放在 had 和過去分詞中間。She had just finished her homework when the phone rang.（電話響時她剛寫完作業。had just finished。）
She had just finished her homework when the phone rang.　（電話響時她剛寫完作業。had just finished。）

practice.stem: 選正確：When we got to the station, the train ____.（我們到車站時火車已經開走了）

distractor_rationales.has already left: 講的是過去的事，用過去完成 had，不用現在完成 has。
distractor_rationales.had already leave: had 後面接過去分詞 left，不用原形 leave。
distractor_rationales.would already leave: would leave 表未來或假設，不能表示過去已完成，要用 had left。

practice.feedback: had + 過去分詞：the train had already left。

practice.stem: 'By the time the firefighters arrived, the house had burned down.' 哪一件事先發生？
practice.answer: 房子燒毀（had burned down）先發生
options: 房子燒毀（had burned down）先發生

distractor_rationales.消防隊抵達先發生: 過去完成 had burned down 表更早發生，所以是房子先燒毀、消防隊後到。
distractor_rationales.兩件事同時發生: 過去完成式就是用來標出先後，不是同時。
distractor_rationales.房子還沒燒毀: had burned down 表示已經燒毀完成了。

practice.feedback: had burned down＝比『抵達』更早發生，房子先燒毀。

practice.stem: 選正確：She ____ her lunch when I called.（我打電話時她已經吃過午餐了）

distractor_rationales.had already ate: had 後面用過去分詞 eaten，不用過去式 ate。
distractor_rationales.has already eaten: 講過去的事用 had，不用現在完成 has。
distractor_rationales.had already eating: had 後面接過去分詞 eaten，不用 V-ing。

practice.feedback: had + already + 過去分詞：had already eaten。

practice.stem: 選正確：I didn't recognize her because she ____ her hair short.（我沒認出她，因為她先前把頭髮剪短了）

distractor_rationales.was cutting: 過去進行表當時正在剪，和『先前已經剪好了』不合，要用 had cut。
distractor_rationales.has cut: 講過去的事用 had，不用現在完成 has。
distractor_rationales.had cutted: cut 的過去分詞還是 cut，沒有 cutted。

practice.feedback: 剪頭髮比沒認出更早：had cut（cut 的過去分詞還是 cut）。

practice.answer: After she had saved enough money, she bought a bike.
options: After she had saved enough money, she bought a bike.
After she has saved enough money, she bought a bike.
After she had save enough money, she bought a bike.
After she had saving enough money, she bought a bike.

distractor_rationales.After she has saved enough money, she bo: 整句講過去，先發生的動作用 had saved，不用現在完成 has saved。
distractor_rationales.After she had save enough money, she bou: had 後面用過去分詞 saved，不用原形 save。
distractor_rationales.After she had saving enough money, she b: had 後面接過去分詞 saved，不用 V-ing。

practice.feedback: 先存錢用 had saved、後買車用簡單過去 bought。

practice.stem: 聽音檔，把整句寫下來（聽寫）。
practice.answer: The movie had already started when we arrived.
practice.feedback: 對照答案自評：had already started（過去完成）、when we arrived、句尾句點有沒有漏。

units.selfeval_note: 翻看答案自己判斷（不自動判讀）；選完進入 SRS 間隔複習。

shadowing.note: 跟著讀＋語調模仿：播音檔→跟著讀→自評（不自動判發音）。前半時間子句稍停、過去完成的 had + 分詞連讀，句尾下收。

lines.text: By the time I woke up, everyone had finished breakfast.
lines.intonation: 前半 By the time I woke up 稍停、had finished 句尾下收

lines.text: She had never flown before that trip.
lines.intonation: never 稍重、句尾 trip 下收
